description: Describe the df_<id> dataframes that fdic_query_financials and fdic_get_deposits staged when a result exceeded its inline preview, plus any that fdic_dataframe_query saved with register_as. Pass name (from a dataset field) for one dataframe in full: source tool, the parameters it was called with, row count, creation and expiry time, column schema, and the unit and basis of each amount, ratio, or count column (thousands of dollars, percent, or count). Read a table's columns this way before writing SQL for fdic_dataframe_query. Omit name to list the live dataframes, newest first, 50 per page, as name, source tool, row count, and expiry only. A deployment that serves HTTP without authentication, where every caller shares one canvas, does not list; there, pass the name a dataset field returned.

name.description: A dataframe name (df_XXXXX_XXXXX, from a dataset field) for its provenance, columns, and units; omit to list the live dataframes where this deployment allows it.

offset.description: Listed dataframes to skip; pass next_offset from the previous page. Ignored when name is set.

name: fdic_dataframe_describe

cap.description: Dataframes per page of the listing.

dataframes.description: The named dataframe in full, or one page of the live dataframes as summary rows, newest first; empty when none matched.

column_schema.description: Columns in table order; present with name.

nullable.description: Whether the column may hold NULL.

type.description: Column type: INTEGER, DOUBLE, VARCHAR, DATE, …

additionalProperties.description: Unit and basis of one column.

basis.description: point_in_time, quarter, quarter_annualized, year_to_date, or ytd_annualized.

unit.description: usd_thousands (thousands of US dollars), percent (1.71 = 1.71%), or count.

column_units.description: Column → unit and basis, for the amount, ratio, and count columns the producing tool labeled; with name only, and absent for register_as dataframes, whose derived columns carry no unit.

created_at.description: When it was staged (ISO 8601); present with name.

max_rows.description: The row cap that bound the source result, when one did; with name only.

name.description: Dataframe name to use in SQL.

query_params.description: Input of the call that staged it (for fdic_dataframe_query, the SQL); present with name.

truncated.description: True when the source result held more rows than were staged; present with name.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas is not configured in this deployment. `listing_unavailable`: name is omitted on a deployment that serves HTTP without authentication, where every caller shares one canvas. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_offset.description: Offset of the next page of the listing; present when more dataframes remain.

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, the page is past the end, the page starts past the first dataframe, or more pages remain.

total.description: Live dataframes across all pages of the listing; with name, 1 or 0.

truncated.description: True when more dataframes remain beyond this page.

title: Describe staged dataframes
